== Dialogue ==
{{Dialogue start}}
:'''Huayu:''' It's been a while, Rover! We solved the mine's crisis all thanks to your help.
:{{Icon|Pharmacy Store}} Yibai Clinic
::(Open Shop)
:{{DIcon|Talk}} What happened next?
::'''Huayu:''' Hmm, everything is slowly returning to the way it was, but there have also been some minor changes.
::'''Huayu:''' For example, the two guys who used to bicker all day long around me now stick together every day to discuss the iteration of the parts and system of the Refinement Tower.
::'''Huayu:''' Hongbo no longer slouches around the places in his memories with his dairies grieving about the old days.
::'''Huayu:''' His diary is no longer about the past but about today and the hopeful tomorrow.
::'''Huayu:''' It seems that he can trust the mine with the younger generation now, all thanks to your help. You are welcome to pay us a visit when you have time.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue end}}
